title: Introduce lightweight credential router, stream operator, and polyglot SDK version sync
author: Marisol Chen
description: Motivation: unify credential routing and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to simplify operator integration and reduce auth-related retry noise. This PR introduces a lightweight credential router (in-sdk orchestrator) that centralizes credential selection, warmup, and telemetry hooks; a small 'stream operator' helper that standardizes backpressure hints and graceful cancelation semantics across async iterables; and coordinated package version bumps to align release windows across languages. Changes include behavioral fixes to retry weight calculation for short-lived credentials, removal of duplicated heartbeat timers between session managers, and added labeled telemetry for credential fetch latency. Checklist: 1) implement cred-router core in each SDK; 2) add stream operator adapter and document examples; 3) update telemetry events and unit tests; 4) bump SDK versions and update CHANGELOGs; 5) run integration tests against hosted CI matrix. Impact: mostly additive ergonomics and bugfixes, small surface API: StreamOperator interface added (backwards-compatible for existing consumers). Linked Linear/Tasks: ENG-2589 SDK cross-lang auth harmonization. Release note: Add lightweight credential router and StreamOperator helper; improved auth telemetry and retry stability. Rollout plan: feature-flagged via runtime toggles for first 48 hours, monitor cred_fetch.latency, stream.resume-errors, and consumer api migrations. Notes: coordinated release with SDK team leads to publish TS 1.29.0, Go 1.14.0, Python 0.11.0. Documentation PRs will be opened in a follow-up for code samples and migration guide.
